description: This script is a test suite for Git repository mirror push operations. It defines functions to set up repository pairs, tests to verify branch and tag mirroring behaviors, and checks for remote mirror configurations. The script includes multiple test cases with expected success and failure conditions for pushing branches and tags between repositories.

methods.name: invert
methods.description: Function to invert the success/failure of a command, returning 0 if the command fails and 1 if it succeeds.

methods.name: mk_repo_pair
methods.description: Sets up a pair of git repositories ('main' and 'mirror') with remote configurations to facilitate mirror push tests.
